question.text: The total number of 'Sigma' and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Pi</mi></math> bonds in 2-formylhex-4-enoic acid is

solution.text:
A single bond is a result of the axial overlap of bonding orbitals. Hence, it contributes a sigma bond. A multiple bond (double or triple bond) contain one sigma bond and the remaining are pi bonds. 

The total number of sigma and pi bond in 

 2-Formyl hex-4-enoic acid is 22.
